## Keywords

## 20.1 A new project

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A video editor keeps the edits in a project, not in the source files.
- We set the resolution and the frame rate first.
- The imported clips appear in the media pool.
- **Do it:** Make a project and import three clips. Where do they appear?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/workflow.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 1 · The project

a) What do we set first in a new project?
b) Where do the imported clips appear?
c) Why does the editor show "media offline"?

::: {.answer}
a) the resolution and the frame rate
b) in the media pool
c) The source files were moved.
:::

## 20.2 Viewer, inspector and timeline

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- The viewer shows the frame at the playhead.
- The inspector shows the settings of the selected clip.
- A clip on V2 covers the clip on V1 below it.
- **Do it:** Put a title on V2 at the start. What does the viewer show?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/editor-window.png)
:::
::::

{{< sim file="sims/timeline-lab.html" poster="sims/timeline-lab.png" title="Timeline Lab: a first cut of the teaser" task="**Show:** add three clips, split the boat chase at 10 s and ripple delete one part, add the title at 0 and trim the music. **Ask:** why does the teaser have no black gap?" >}}

## Example · The title over the gameplay

Tariq builds the first teaser of Rooftop Rescue for the trainee.
**How does the title get over the gameplay?**

::: {.reveal}
1. The three clips go onto **V1**, one after the other.
2. The text title goes onto **V2**, above the first clip.
3. In the **inspector**, the title gets smaller and moves up.
:::

## Try it 2 · The panels

a) Which panel changes the size of a title?
b) Which track does a title over the gameplay need?
c) What does the playhead mark?

::: {.answer}
a) the inspector
b) V2
c) the frame shown in the viewer
:::

## 20.3 The four basic edits

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Split cuts a clip in two at the playhead.
- Trim drags the start or the end of a clip.
- Ripple delete removes a part and closes the gap.
- **Do it:** Remove the middle of a clip. Which edits did you use?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/edit-tools.png)
:::
::::

## Example · The boring middle

Seconds 4–8 of the 9-second boat chase are boring.
**How does Tariq remove them?**

::: {.reveal}
1. The playhead goes to 4 s and 8 s of the clip, with a **split** at each.
2. The middle part is **ripple deleted**, so no black gap stays.
3. The music is now too long, so its end is **trimmed** to the end of the video.
:::

## Try it 3 · The trainee (harder)

a) How do we cut the boat clip at 0:12?
b) Which page makes an MP4 for the store?
c) Why do we not send the project file?

::: {.answer}
a) playhead to 0:12, then split
b) Deliver
c) It needs the editor and all the source files.
:::

## Summary

- We set the resolution and the frame rate first, and import into the media pool.
- The viewer shows the playhead's frame, and the inspector shows the selected clip.
- Higher video tracks cover lower ones, and all audio tracks play at once.
- Split, trim, ripple delete and move build the edit.
- We export an MP4 with H.264 and watch it once.
